name: media
title: Media
description: Table with media files recorded during deployments. Files may be local paths or external URLs. No assumption is made that files are bundled in the package.

fields.name: mediaID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the media file.

fields.name: deploymentID
fields.description: Identifier of the deployment the media file belongs to. Foreign key to `deployments.deploymentID`.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time at which the media file was captured. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: URL or relative path to the media file.

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Name of the media file. If provided, files should sort chronologically within a deployment on `timestamp` then `fileName`.

fields.name: fileMediatype
fields.description: IANA Media Type of the file.

fields.name: filePublic
fields.description: `false` if the media file is not publicly accessible. Pair with `embargoUntil` and package `licenses` (`scope=media`). This is the Camtrap-compatible media-privacy flag.

fields.name: embargoUntil
fields.description: Date after which this file may be made public. ISO 8601 date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty means no media embargo beyond the deployment.

fields.name: fileHash
fields.description: Cryptographic hash of the file for integrity and evidence. Prefixed as `algorithm:hex` (e.g. `sha256:`).

fields.name: mediaRole
fields.description: Role of this file in the evidence chain. `primary` is the observation frame. `raw` is a camera original. `derived` is a processed product. `thumbnail` is a preview. `calibration` is a color card, SQM, or scale reference.

fields.name: derivedFromMediaID
fields.description: If this file is processed from another package media file, the source `mediaID`.

fields.name: captureMethod
fields.description: How the media was captured.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: Person or organization that created the media file.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Capture latitude when it differs from the deployment location (handheld GPS). Decimal degrees, WGS84. Omit when `spatialPrivacy` is `withheld`.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Capture longitude when it differs from the deployment location. Decimal degrees, WGS84.

fields.name: coordinateUncertainty
fields.description: Horizontal uncertainty of the media capture coordinates, in meters.

fields.name: elevation
fields.description: Elevation or altitude at capture.

fields.name: calibrationTarget
fields.description: Reference target present in or associated with the frame, enabling later photometric or colorimetric use.

fields.name: exifData
fields.description: Selected EXIF or XMP data as a JSON object. Omit fields already modeled as columns. Strip GPS tags when `filePublic` is false or coordinates are withheld.

fields.name: favorite
fields.description: `true` if the file is an exemplar or preferred public evidence frame.

fields.name: mediaComments
fields.description: Comments or notes about the media file.
